title: Large-scale AI-Ready Data for Anti-Cancer Drug Response Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2608.11444v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Drug response prediction (DRP) models are an active area of research in pharmacogenomics, with growing potential to accelerate the identification of effective anticancer drugs. However, their predictive performance is often constrained by limited dataset scale and insufficient coverages of cancer and chemical spaces. In addition, inconsistent benchmarking practices hinder reliable comparison across models. Standardized frameworks, such as the Innovative Methodologies and New Data for Predictive Oncology Model Evaluation (IMPROVE) project, provide unified data schemas and evaluation protocols for consistent benchmarking, but improving model generalizability requires larger and more diverse training data. In this work, we substantially expand the IMPROVE benchmark through large-scale integration of pharmacogenomic data, primarily from PharmacoDB, together with additional smaller data sources. translated_title: 面向抗癌药物反应建模的大规模AI就绪数据
translated_abstract: 药物反应预测（DRP）模型是药物基因组学中的一个活跃研究领域，在加速识别有效抗癌药物方面具有日益增长的潜力。然而，它们的预测性能常常受到有限数据集规模以及癌症和化学空间覆盖不足的限制。此外，不一致的基准测试实践阻碍了模型间的可靠比较。标准化框架，如创新方法论和预测肿瘤学模型评估新数据（IMPROVE）项目，提供了统一的数据模式和评估协议以实现一致的基准测试，但提高模型的泛化能力需要更大、更多样化的训练数据。在这项工作中，我们通过大规模整合药物基因组学数据（主要来自PharmacoDB，以及额外的小型数据源）大幅扩展了IMPROVE基准。扩展后的资源包括数百万个药物反应数据点。
tldr: 本文通过大规模整合药物基因组学数据（主要来自PharmacoDB）大幅扩展了IMPROVE基准，提供了数百万个AI就绪的药物反应数据点，以提升抗癌药物反应预测模型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: This work substantially expands the IMPROVE benchmark by large-scale integration of pharmacogenomic data, primarily from PharmacoDB, providing millions of AI-ready drug response data points to enhance the generalizability of anti-cancer drug response prediction models.
